sections.content:
Population change in Babergh in 2032

The population in Babergh is projected to increase from 94,287 people in 2022 to 102,522 people in 2032.

The biggest factor in this population change is net internal migration, which will increase the population by 12,341 people.

This will also be the biggest factor in population change in most areas in England.

sections.title: Contributors to population change in Babergh
sections.subtitle: How the population is projected to change, by cause
sections.source: Subnational population projections for England from Office for National Statistics – Migration category variant
sections.note: The components of change do not always sum exactly to the total population change in an area. This is primarily due to the effect of constraining the final projections to the National Population Projections for England.

sections.content:
Population change is projected by looking at births and deaths (natural change) and people moving in and out of areas. In Babergh, our projections show that between 2022 and 2032:

  • More deaths than births mean that the population is projected to decrease by 4,454, with 7,440 births and 11,894 deaths in Babergh between 2022 and 2032. This means natural change would decrease the population in Babergh by 4.7%, compared with an increase of 0.2% in England.
  • Net internal migration (people moving to and from other local authorities in England) is projected to increase the population by 12,341, with 67,475 people moving to the area and 55,134 people moving from the area between 2022 and 2032. This would increase the population in Babergh by 13.1%.
  • Net cross-border migration (between UK nations) is projected to reduce the population by 457, with 894 people moving to the area and 1,351 people moving from the area between 2022 and 2032. This would decrease the population in Babergh by 0.5%.
  • Net international migration is projected to increase the population by 862, with 2,219 people moving to the area and 1,357 people moving from the area between 2022 and 2032. This would increase the population in Babergh by 0.9%, compared with an increase of 6.5% in England.

sections.content:
Age profile in Babergh in 2032

The median age in Babergh is projected to rise from 49 years in 2022 to 50 years in 2032.

In England, the median age is projected to be 41 years in 2032.

In 2032, 29% of the population in Babergh are projected to be aged 65 years or over, up from 26% in 2022.

sections.title: The 50 to 59 age group are set to see the largest change in Babergh between 2022 and 2032
sections.subtitle: Percentages of population by 10 year age bands, 2022 and 2032
sections.source: Subnational population projections for England from Office for National Statistics – Migration category variant

sections.content:
Between 2022 and 2032, the share of the working age population (people aged 16 years to State Pension age) in Babergh is projected to stay the same, at around 56%.

The old age dependency ratio (the number of people of State Pension age for every 1,000 people of working age) is projected to rise from 440 to 480 over the same time period.

This is above average for England in 2032 (287 per 1,000). Nationally, a high old age dependency ratio means more older people are financially reliant on the working age population to pay for pensions.

How will the number of young people change in Babergh?

In 2032, 18% of people are projected to be aged 18 years and under, down from 19% in 2022.

This is below average for England in 2032 (20%).

Looking at the youngest age groups in Babergh between 2022 and 2032, we can see the share of:

  • Infants (aged 0 to 4 years) will stay around the same, at 4%
  • Primary school age children (aged 5 to 11 years) will fall from 7% to 6%
  • Secondary school age children and sixth-form age (aged 12 to 18 years) will fall from 8% to 7%
